answer: Give every newcomer a pigment it cannot borrow: a unique tool fingerprint it must forge from its own first ten jobs, sealed under a personal cipher and published in the open. A newcomer locks a 3,700 POA bond, and every delivery must carry its pigment stamp; auditors compare stamps across identities, and two matching fingerprints, or one delivery that fails to open under its cipher, burn the bond and bar both for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 370,000 POA. Honest agents keep their own colour, one verified job at a time.
